sources: Google Maps panel for Big Eddy Campground, read 2026-11-02
summary: Operator site refused my request, so nothing confirmed from its pages and no group changed. Rate, RV-site locations and riverfront remain unverified; phone found on Google; rated 4.8/108.
flags: UNREAD: https://bigeddy.chewonki.org answered 403 (Cloudflare block) to the plain request; per the brief I did not retry or go through the browser, and the booking link is only reachable from that site. So rates, RV sites, hookups, season, ownership wording are all unread. A person needs to open it, or you can tell me to use the driver.

NO RATE: none stored and none read from the operator. RV Life tier $$, avg $21, 62 sites; campers report $15 in 2018 and $27 in 2006, too old to use. Passes on PRESENCE (Google open, 108 reviews, phone) and PRICE (RV Life $$).

PHONE: Google gives (207) 882-7323, which isn't stored (empty). Address 'Golden Rd, Millinocket, ME 04462'. Google links to bigeddy.chewonki.org. Unconfirmed against the operator's own page. apply.py doesn't write phone.

OWNERSHIP: stored note says Chewonki Foundation runs it (nonprofit-run = private, as stored). I could not read that on the operator's site; the hostname is the only support I saw. RV Life lists it as commercial.

WATERFRONT unresolved, riverfront stored: I can't plot RV sites. Imagery: the river is ~80 m wide at the eddy, so riverfront not creekside by width; open apron and pads reach the south bank by the office, and clearings run along the bank east of it. A Google review calls the bank spot the day use area ('We used the day use area for a lovely picnic at waters edge'), which can't count. RV Life 2006: 'primitive sites are huge along the office side of the Penobscot River'; 2018: 'situated on the Penobscot River'. If you want the rule applied now without the operator's pages, it is a downgrade to riverview; I'd read the site first. Not edited.

REVIEWS: Google 4.8 from 108; RV Life 5 stars from 3 ratings. Quotes, Google: 'Only negative is the roads to get there. Very rough unpaved roads that will take an hour and a half from Greenville or 1 hours from Millinocket. Probably 19 mph max.' (3 months ago); 'Rustic camp with 2 shower/ toilet rooms. No cell service, WiFi at the office only.' (same); '$2 showers located next to the office' (4 months ago); 'Great campground, split on either side of the river. One side is disconnected from the main office, considered the wild side' (2 years ago). No gateway within 40 km (Acadia NP 177 km), not needed at the reported rates.

ACCESS: Golden Road is gravel per the note and rough per the review above; I read no vehicle limit or toll. Whether a 23-ft motorhome is advised is unread. Stored 'no hookups' rests on note prose; a 2018 RV Life review agrees (spigots only, electricity in the office). Left as is.
SPLIT not flagged: a review says two sides of the river, but I measured no separate entrances; imagery shows clearings on the north bank at ~200 m, no bridge seen.
PIN fine: stored 45.87574,-69.1298 sits at the office entrance off the Golden Road; RV Life uses the same point.
